mathematics.assertion_tested: Finite nilpotent exp/log inverse, cutoff independence, naturality, nonzero sample recovery and kernel equality on the declared deterministic matrix suite; known truncation and zero-sample failures.

bounds.rectangular_generators: For each a,b, s=0,...,min(a,b)-1; image of final source basis vector is target e_s.
bounds.selection: Constructed deterministic suite; the stated finite loops are exhaustive over their declared parameters only.

mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q represented by Python fractions.Fraction and exact integers
mathematics.conventions: Column vectors; N has superdiagonal ones on each Jordan block; exp(N)=sum N^j/j!; log(I+X)=sum (-1)^(j+1) X^j/j. Rectangular H maps source to target and satisfies N_target H=H N_source. The affine group law is (t,z)(u,w)=(t+3^z*u,z+w).
non_claims: Not a universal proof or exhaustive classification of nilpotent rational matrices.
No arithmetic Galois-to-Weil-Deligne attachment, coefficient comparison, Hodge-Tate theory, analytic convergence, or novelty claim.
Finite tests do not establish the full five partial arithmetic claims.
